'''Joren Hunt''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]. He was an associate of [[Thadius Black]] on [[Demophon]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], where he helped smuggle political prisoners away from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="I" />
